## Final Synthesis: `tmp/mcgo/` — Complete Verified State

The project has been fully reviewed, all identified issues fixed, and the build verified. Here is the conclusive final report.

### Project Overview
**MiniCraft** — a Minecraft-style game prototype in Go using Ebitengine v2.

### File Structure (All Verified on Disk)

```
tmp/mcgo/
├── go.mod                        — module github.com/united-poo/mcgo, ebiten/v2 v2.9.9
├── go.sum                        — dependency checksums
├── main.go                       (5.2 KB) — game loop, input handling, orchestration
├── block/block.go                (1.5 KB) — block types, properties, solid/opaque checks
├── camera/camera.go              (2.5 KB) — ⚠️ unused camera struct (dead code, not imported)
├── player/player.go              (3.9 KB) — player physics, collision, EyeHeight constant
├── player/interaction.go         (2.3 KB) — raycasting, block interaction logic
├── render/render.go              (10.7 KB) — software rasteriser, mesh building, fillTriangle
└── world/
    ├── chunk.go                  (2.0 KB) — chunk data structure, block storage
    ├── generator.go              (2.8 KB) — Perlin noise terrain generation
    └── world.go                  (4.5 KB) — world management, LoadRadius, UnloadFarChunks
```

### Build Status
```
$ cd /Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code/tmp/mcgo
$ go build ./...
# zero errors, zero warnings ✓
```

### All 8 Fixes + 1 Bonus Fix — Verified

| # | Fix | Severity | File(s) | Verified |
|---|-----|----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | `Indices` changed `uint16→uint32` to prevent vertex overflow (>65536) | **CRITICAL** | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 2 | Duplicate back-face culling block removed (only 1 `if -nz >= 0` remains) | Medium | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 3 | `fillTriangle` bottom-half: `mx1`=y2→y3 edge, `mx2`=y1→y3 edge, `sx2` correctly interpolated to y2 | **HIGH** | `render/render.go` | ✓ |
| 4 | Dead `if/else` branch removed from `collides()` | Low | `player/player.go` | ✓ |
| 5 | Redundant `castRay` wrapper unified to single `castRay()` returning `HitResult` directly | Low | `main.go` | ✓ |
| 6 | Right-click placement uses AABB overlap (0.3×1.8 hitbox vs full unit cube) instead of point check | Low | `main.go` | ✓ |
| 7 | `UnloadFarChunks(cx, cz, keepRadius)` added; called in `Update()`; stale meshes cleaned up | **HIGH** | `world/world.go`, `main.go` | ✓ |
| 8 | `render.go.fix` absent (fix applied directly to `render.go`) | Low | filesystem | ✓ |
| Bonus | `EyeHeight = 1.6` constant added to `player.go`; `main.go` uses `player.EyeHeight` | Low | `player/player.go`, `main.go` | ✓ |

### Remaining Caveats (Not Fixed — Deferred or Intentional)

| Caveat | Location | Reason |
|--------|----------|--------|
| `camera` package is dead code (~110 lines, never imported) | `camera/camera.go` | Keep as scaffolding for future camera-relative rendering |
| `blockColors` duplicated in `render.go` vs `block.Properties` | `render/render.go` | Minor refactoring target — no functional impact |
| Water blocks invisible (skipped in mesh building) | `render/render.go` | Deferred for future transparency/water shader pass |
| `drawFog` empty stub | `render/render.go` | Reserved for future atmospheric effects |
| Tree placement height range narrow (30–34) | `world/generator.go` | Works for current flat terrain; revisit with varied terrain |
| No dirty-chunk optimisation list | `render/render.go`, `main.go` | Performance optimisation — not critical at current draw volumes |

### Summary

The `tmp/mcgo/` codebase has undergone a complete review and fix cycle. **Three critical/high-severity bugs** were fixed:

1. **Vertex index overflow** (`uint16` → `uint32`) — would cause silent triangle corruption on large chunks
2. **fillTriangle bottom-half edge mismatch** — would produce visible rendering artefacts
3. **Missing chunk unloading** — would cause unbounded memory growth as the player moves

**Five medium/low-severity fixes** were also applied: duplicate code removal, dead code cleanup, API unification, proper collision checking, and constant extraction.

The project compiles cleanly and is in a demonstrably improved, stable state, ready for further development or gameplay iteration.

END_STEP
